# Synthetic unprotected MPS fixtures

`scripts/make_mps_fixtures.py` independently assembles synthetic CFB containers,
supported wrapper headers, and zlib members. The document, mixed-primitive,
block, and extended-header fixtures test exact decoded bytes, separate source
domains, checksum/EOF checks, and read-policy boundaries.

These are project-authored fixtures with no copied native drawing payloads.
Unknown extension fields remain unsupported. Run the generator with `--check`
to compare all generated bytes without replacing files.
